RENDERING_RULES_AND_NEGATIVE_PROMPT_INST: Render text only from exact_* fields within layout_and_content_blocks.
All canvas and block fills are pure WHITE #FFFFFF; colors appear only on borders and linework.
NO semantic icons: no sun, cloud, photovoltaic panel, desert, badge, document, lock, fire or lightning graphics.
Every main block has an abstract geometric visual anchor built only from short strokes, open brackets, small outlines or native editable lines; not a pictorial icon.
NO emojis, NO 3D rendering, NO gradients, NO drop shadows, NO textures.
No plots, axes, waveforms, measured values, claimed improvements, invented experiments, institutional logos or maps.
Main connectors are solid dark-gray arrows; no feedback loop or additional connection.
Preserve all Chinese labels exactly, including punctuation; no English translation.
Do not add tensor dimensions, layer counts, model internals, equations or new modules.
Do not render captions, source paragraphs, gap IDs or JSON field names.
Keep all labels legible at 155mm print width; 8.5pt minimum.
C3 receives raw quantile grid plus complete historical out-of-sample errors; calibration is a separate diagnostic branch.
Never draw any arrow from calibration/diagnosis to C3, its trajectories, or event probabilities.
Use only two active chromatic colors; #5BA0D0 stays inactive. Geometric anchors are #4D4D4D. Overall figure title stays in the external caption.
caption_note: C1 fixes usable variables/scales and sample indices for C2.
C2 feeds C3 only the original monotonic quantile grid and complete historical rolling-holdout error vectors after every horizon label has arrived.
Calibrated 80%/90% intervals are separate reliability diagnostics; their endpoints do not constitute a fully calibrated joint distribution.
The three C3 comparison groups are independent ordering, overall historical ranks, and weather-conditioned historical ranks; details are reserved for F05.
No actual performance, station count, forecast skill or deployment status is claimed.
caption_zh: 总体研究框架。C1确定可利用输入，C2形成原始分位预测并单独评价区间校准，C3使用原始网格与完整历史误差检验依赖贡献。所有模块均为拟开展工作。
anchor: \textbf{总体路线。}以获得合法使用条件的功率和气象数据为起点，先建立发布时刻的信息集合并识别可利用的时间尺度，内容一据此输出可追溯样本和变量选择依据。内容二在同一数据划分上训练概率模型并保存边际预测、到齐标签和连续误差向量；内容三接收这些产物，通过同边际轨迹对照检验爬坡概率，再将验证集确定的决策规则接入离线原型。三项内容在数据、概率输出和事件评价之间依次衔接，最终以独立时间段与天气过程检验总体目标。
